A database is deleted and made again under its name, so its native ID is another. Four sources state it: a read of the account, the configuration with the native ID, a file with the name alone, a file with the name and the account. All are read again. Nothing states the first database now, so the two names do not stay with its node: they fit the node of the new native ID, which the read states, and the first node leaves the model.
